doubts.claim_under_doubt: probe yes means the Viewer can open the file
doubts.disproof_attempt: probe.ts checks decide + MIME extension + regular file only; GET also rejects file_too_large (413) and NUL text (415). Oversize file probes openable:true.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Report size > FILE_MAX_BYTES as not previewable (st.size on the handle); NUL sniff rebuttal acceptable.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: useOpenable expiry re-checks a stale no
doubts.disproof_attempt: stale is computed only during render; no timer, so a quiet memoized chip stays dead.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Timer that bumps a tick when the answer is no.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Removing Detail tab leaves no dead state
doubts.disproof_attempt: MissionBody keeps docRequest/activeNode across a task switch if it is not remounted per task; keyed sidebar replays the previous request on mount.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Key MissionBody by taskId or show it already remounts.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: terminal async filter cannot produce stale links
doubts.disproof_attempt: links built from buffer snapshot; filter resolves up to seconds later; filter reads latest.current at call time.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Accept or recheck line text; activation is guarded.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: probe is no oracle and does not widen V4
doubts.disproof_attempt: Held: evidence first, 403/400 collapse, realpath canon, handle-based. Residual: rate limit per task consumes scans (30x40 per 10s).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: probed path form equals opened path form
doubts.disproof_attempt: Forms match for chips, outputs and terminal.

summary: 6 doubts: 3 medium, 3 low. Server oracle/V4 widening attempt came up empty.
